summary: Build the identity layer at packages/python/src/sox_protocol/core/identity/ as a self-contained module with three concerns: (1) a credential registry that stores (agent_id, public_key, registered_at, revoked_at?) tuples and verifies Ed25519 signatures over the canonical signed-request envelope (agent_id, nonce, timestamp, method, body-hash); (2) an identity verifier callable that wraps the registry and produces a verified agent_id from a signed request, raising IdentityFailure on any rejection; (3) an audit-log writer that emits one JSON line per rejection. The module exposes a stable public API consumable by the upcoming hooks-middleware engagement: CredentialRegistry (port + in-memory reference impl), SignedRequest dataclass, IdentityVerifier.verify(signed_request) -> VerifiedIdentity, and IdentityFailure exception hierarchy. A thin standalone `IdentityMiddleware` adapter is provided so identity can short-circuit calls before backing-store access is wired into the MCP server today; the hooks-middleware engagement will rebind this same verifier as the `auth` plugin in the chain. Build order: registry then verifier then audit then middleware adapter then tests. All audit-log writes target ~/.sox/logs/identity-failures.jsonl at runtime; tests redirect via an injectable path.

files.purpose: Public re-exports forming the stable identity API consumed by hooks-middleware.
Typed exception hierarchy for identity failures; each carries a stable error_code matching sox-error.schema.json.
public_api: class IdentityFailure(Exception): error_code: str = 'identity_failure'; reason: str

files.purpose: Canonical signed-request envelope dataclass plus body-hash computation; defines the exact bytes that get signed.
public_api: @dataclass(frozen=True) class SignedRequest(agent_id: str, nonce: str, timestamp: float, method: str, body_hash: str, signature: bytes)
@dataclass(frozen=True) class VerifiedIdentity(agent_id: str, verified_at: float, connection_id: str | None)

files.purpose: CredentialRegistry ABC plus in-memory reference implementation; stores (agent_id, public_key, registered_at, revoked_at?) and answers lookup/revocation queries. Append-only.
public_api: @dataclass(frozen=True) class CredentialRecord(agent_id: str, public_key: bytes, registered_at: float, revoked_at: float | None)

class CredentialRegistry(ABC): async def register(agent_id, public_key) -> CredentialRecord; async def revoke(agent_id) -> None; async def lookup(agent_id) -> CredentialRecord | None; async def all_records() -> list[CredentialRecord]

files.purpose: IdentityVerifier glues registry + envelope + replay cache; verify() returns VerifiedIdentity or raises a typed IdentityFailure subclass. Replay cache TTL is configurable; default 5 minutes per ADR 0002 open question.
public_api: class IdentityVerifier(registry: CredentialRegistry, audit: AuditLogWriter, *, replay_window_seconds: float = 300.0, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time)
async def verify(self, request: SignedRequest, *, operation: str, connection_id: str | None = None) -> VerifiedIdentity
async def bind_for_send(self, request: SignedRequest, send_input: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]  # overwrites sender per spec §2

files.purpose: Append-only JSONL writer for identity failures. Default path ~/.sox/logs/identity-failures.jsonl (created at runtime, not at import); injectable for tests. One line per rejection: {ts, claimed_agent_id, reason, operation, connection_id}.
public_api: class AuditLogWriter(path: pathlib.Path | None = None, *, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time)
async def record_failure(self, *, claimed_agent_id: str | None, reason: str, operation: str, connection_id: str | None) -> None

files.purpose: Standalone IdentityMiddleware that wraps IdentityVerifier with a callable signature compatible with the upcoming middleware pipeline (handle(request, next)). Will be repackaged as the `auth` plugin during the hooks-middleware engagement; module docstring documents that migration seam.
public_api: async def __call__(self, request: dict[str, object], call_next: Callable[[dict[str, object]], Awaitable[dict[str, object]]]) -> dict[str, object]

files.purpose: Ed25519 helpers: generate keypair, load private key from path (mode 0600 enforced), sign canonical payload. Wraps the cryptography library so the rest of core stays algorithm-agnostic.
public_api: def sign(private_key: Ed25519PrivateKey, payload: bytes) -> bytes
def verify_signature(public_key: bytes, payload: bytes, signature: bytes) -> bool

files.purpose: Fixtures: tmp audit-log path, deterministic clock, fresh InMemoryCredentialRegistry, sample agent keypair, helper to build SignedRequest from a body dict.
Validate registry append-only semantics, lookup, revocation behaviour.
Canonical payload determinism + body-hash stability across key reorderings.
Verify happy-path success, every failure mode, sender overwrite for send().
Integration: a rejected verify() yields exactly one JSONL line with required fields and no leakage.
IdentityMiddleware short-circuits unverified requests before call_next runs; verified requests forward with mutated sender; ensures backing-store is not reachable on rejection.
Keypair generation, sign/verify roundtrip, file mode 0600 enforcement on load.

test_cases: test_send_overwrites_sender_with_verified_id — bind_for_send replaces caller-claimed sender with the verified agent_id
test_client_cannot_inject_sender — SignedRequest.method='send' with mismatched body.sender field still produces verified sender from agent_id binding
test_send_requires_verification — IdentityMiddleware short-circuits unverified send before call_next
test_subscribe_requires_verification — same for subscribe
test_recv_requires_verification — same for recv; recv result is filtered to verified agent_id only
test_list_channels_passes_through_when_unauthenticated — informational op is not gated
test_unknown_agent_returns_identity_failure — raises UnknownAgentError mapping to error_code 'identity_failure'
test_revoked_credential_rejected — RevokedCredentialError on signed request from revoked agent
test_signature_mismatch_rejected — SignatureMismatchError when payload tampered
test_replay_within_window_rejected — second use of same nonce inside replay_window_seconds raises ReplayDetectedError
test_replay_outside_window_accepted — nonce reuse after window expiry succeeds (with new timestamp)
test_no_partial_state_on_failure — failed verify() does not mutate registry or audit cache invariants
test_error_message_does_not_leak_other_agent_ids — message string omits other registered agents
test_rejection_writes_one_audit_line — exactly one JSONL line per failure
test_audit_line_has_required_fields — ts, claimed_agent_id, reason, operation, connection_id present
test_audit_line_has_no_secrets — no signature, public_key, or body bytes appear in audit line
test_audit_path_default — default_audit_path() resolves to ~/.sox/logs/identity-failures.jsonl (string equality, no FS write in this test)
test_agent_id_not_in_send_input_schema — bind_for_send tolerates send input without agent_id key (server injects)
test_verifier_persists_binding_across_calls — same connection_id reusing nonce-distinct requests succeeds without re-registration
test_registry_records_required_columns — CredentialRecord exposes agent_id, public_key, registered_at, revoked_at
test_registry_is_append_only — revoke() sets revoked_at but does not remove the record
test_lookup_returns_none_for_unknown — lookup of unknown agent_id returns None (not raises)
test_ed25519_sign_verify_roundtrip — signature produced by sign() validates with verify_signature()
test_load_private_key_rejects_world_readable — file mode 0644 is rejected; 0600 succeeds
test_canonical_payload_is_deterministic — reordering body keys does not change body_hash
test_middleware_short_circuits_before_call_next — unverified request: call_next is NOT awaited
test_middleware_propagates_response_on_success — verified request: call_next response is returned unchanged

risks.risk: Audit-log path ~/.sox/logs/ does not exist at runtime; first failure raises FileNotFoundError instead of logging.
risks.mitigation: AuditLogWriter mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) on first write; covered by test_rejection_writes_one_audit_line using a tmp path.

risks.risk: Replay-window default (5 min) conflicts with future ADR pinning a different value.
risks.mitigation: Make replay_window_seconds a constructor arg with documented default; the open question in ADR 0002 will configure it later without API change.

risks.risk: Hooks-middleware engagement may want a different signature than IdentityMiddleware.__call__.
risks.mitigation: IdentityVerifier is the canonical surface and is signature-stable; IdentityMiddleware is a thin adapter the hooks-middleware engagement is free to rewrite using the same verifier.

risks.risk: InMemoryCredentialRegistry is not a real persistence layer; tests may accidentally rely on it as an adapter.
risks.mitigation: Document in registry.py docstring that this is a reference impl for tests and pre-adapter wiring; the SQLite/filesystem adapters land in a separate engagement.

risks.risk: cryptography dependency may already be transitively present; double-pinning could cause version drift.
risks.mitigation: Add cryptography>=41 to packages/python/pyproject.toml [project.dependencies] in implementation phase only if absent; otherwise import-only.

exit_signals: lint-imports clean (core/identity MUST NOT import from sox_protocol.adapters)
ruff check clean on src/sox_protocol/core/identity/ and tests/identity/

audit log appends one JSONL line to the configured path on every rejection (verified by test_audit_log.py against tmp path; runtime default ~/.sox/logs/identity-failures.jsonl is documented and exercised once via subprocess in test_audit_log.py)
Public API in __init__.py is stable and consumable by hooks-middleware engagement (pinned by test_imports smoke check inside test_middleware.py)
